Layout: grid: regular glyph cells. rain: falling columns with trails that reveal the picture. tunnel: polar layout of angle by depth around the centre.
Charset: Glyph characters ordered dark to bright; cell luminance picks one.
Fontname: Font used to draw the glyph atlas. Use a monospace font.
Cols: Number of glyph columns across the image (sets cell size). Rows follow the aspect with 1:2 cells.
Speed: Scroll speed for rain and tunnel layouts. Has no effect in grid.
Contrast: Contrast of the luminance to glyph mapping. Higher = more extreme glyph choices.
Invert: Reverse the glyph choice, so dark areas get dense glyphs.
Brightness: Gain of the glyphs. Higher = brighter characters.
Background: Amount of dim original image shown behind the glyphs (0 = black).
Tail: Rain layout: trail length behind each falling head, in rows.
Trailfloor: Rain layout: minimum visibility (0-1) between trails. 0 = only trails show, higher reveals more of the picture.
Twist: Tunnel layout: spiral twist of the cells with depth. 0 = straight.
Seed: Random seed for per-column speeds and rain glyph choices.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Look: original: glyphs use input colours. mono: bone-white/grey glyphs, optionally with red accents.
Accent: Mono look: fraction (0-1) of glyphs in bright areas drawn red. 0 = none.
